claim: The 2024 Mihintale stele transmits the Theravada chronicle sequence linking a Third Buddhist Council, fixing of the canon and subsequent missionary dispatch.
bounded_by: This is a claim about the tradition transmitted by a modern commemorative inscription, not independent contemporary evidence for the ancient council, canon formation or mission chronology.
notes: Promoted from GF-MIH-01 in Run27; keep textual tradition distinct from epigraphic/archaeological proof.
